mentions.name: mooomooo
mentions.description: A project management tool intended to replace issue trackers like JIRA and Linear, built on a unified data model that adapts to solo developers, small teams, and large organizations, with automated ticket workflow transitions so tickets don't have to be manually moved to done.
mentions.problem: The author hates JIRA and dislikes having to manually move tickets to done in existing project tracking tools.
mentions.audience: Solo developers, small teams, and huge orgs
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building mooomooo, which is my idea of what it means to replace tools like JIRA, linear, and such with a unified data model that can adapt to solo devs, small teams and huge orgs so I don't have to manually move tickets to done.

evidence.value: I'm building mooomooo, which is my idea of what it means to replace tools like JIRA, linear, and such with a unified data model that can adapt to solo devs, small teams and huge orgs so I don't have to manually move tickets to done.
